title: Ethiopian Lentil Stew with French Twist
description: A rich and flavorful stew combining the traditional Ethiopian flavors with a French twist, perfect for a cold winter night.

ingredients.name: lentils
ingredients.notes: red or green lentils work well

ingredients.name: misir wot spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most African or Middle Eastern markets

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onion, garlic, carrot, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the misir wot spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, tomato paste, red wine, and beef broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
Traditionally, this stew is served over injera bread, but it also pairs well with crusty bread or over rice.
